title: Great light set!!
text: Great light set!!. I am amazed at how bright these tiny lights really are! The box that holds the 3 aa batteries is easy to open and has no screws lol !! The wiring is a bit thicker than I would have thought making it much more sturdy and harder to break with bending and shaping. Def.worth the price!!!
